title: Columbo
description:
S10 E5 — No Time to Die
Columbo attends his nephew's wedding and as the couple get ready to leave on their honeymoon, the bride disappears; Columbo investigates and suspects his nephew may have made a few enemies on the police force.

title: Columbo
description:
S10 E6 — A Bird in the Hand..
Columbo investigates a hit-and-run, followed by a car explosion.

title: Columbo
description:
S10 E7 — It's All in the Game
Two women kill their two-timing lover but have solid alibis; one of the women tries to seduce Columbo to keep him off her trail.

title: Columbo
description:
S10 E8 — Butterfly in Shades of Grey
Columbo investigates a case involving argumentative radio talk show host Fielding Chase.

title: Columbo
description:
S10 E9 — Undercover
The disheveled detective sets out to solve an unusual double murder in which two men have apparently killed each other.

title: Columbo
description:
S10 E10 — Strange Bedfellows
The detective is put on the case of a man who murders his brother.

title: Columbo
description:
S10 E11 — A Trace of Murder
Columbo matches wits with a forensics specialist, helping his girlfriend to frame her husband for a stockbroker's murder.

title: Columbo
description:
S10 E12 — Ashes to Ashes
The inimitable cop must prove that a flamboyant Hollywood gossip reporter was murdered by her former lover.

title: Columbo
description:
S10 E13 — Murder With Too Many Notes
A Hollywood film composer and conductor murders a talented, young musician out of jealousy.

title: Ransom for a Dead Man
description:
S1
Lt. Columbo (Peter Falk) outwits a lawyer (Lee Grant) who has killed her husband but made it look like a kidnapping.

title: Columbo
description:
S1 E4 — Suitable for Framing
Columbo is caught in a case of stolen art and murder with evidence pointing to an innocent woman.
